unit: Unit 12: Everyday Life with Your Computer
title: Writing something down and keeping it
drDigitalIntro:
Writing a note is easy. Finding it again a month later is the part people get wrong.
• When you save something, the computer asks two questions: what is it called, and where does it go.
• A name like 'Untitled 3' answers neither. A name like 'shopping-list' answers both.
• Putting it in Documents rather than leaving it loose means you know where to look next time.
• Save a note into Documents here, then do the same on your own computer in the next lesson.

playgroundTask.goal: You saved a note somewhere you will find it again

steps.say: Click Documents in the list on the left, so you can see where the note is going.
Save your note as shopping-list, into Documents.

drDigitalSuccess: Named, and in a folder you chose. That note is findable in a month.
drDigitalHint: Use the Save button, give the note a name that describes it, and pick Documents as the destination.
